svg.title: TicketFlow-AI architecture
svg.desc: A customer ticket passes through Intake, Triage, Retrieval, Response and an Escalation check. It ends in auto-resolve or a human team, and every finished ticket is logged for human review and offline learning.
svg.text: then back to Intake, or hand to a human
Human team via Jira, no draft
Human team via Jira, no draft
Search the knowledge base for evidence
Low confidence: rewrite query and retry once
LLM drafts a reply from the retrieved evidence
Weak evidence: fixed holding message + review flag
needs review · negative sentiment · high complexity
refund amount missing or over 50 · prior contact unresolved
Dashed arrow = external call or logging only
